bullets.text: Malawi's Digital Access Gap – A new GSMA report reveals that 80% of Malawians remain offline despite mobile coverage, highlighting barriers to digital adoption that could hinder economic growth.
Huawei and HP Patent Deal – Huawei has signed a global patent licensing agreement with HP, marking a significant step in commercialising its Wi-Fi technology innovations.
EE Launches 5G Fast Lane – EE introduces a premium 5G network slicing service, ensuring high-quality mobile service for users during peak times at busy events.
Project Gigabit Progress Update – Building Digital UK reports that over 296,000 premises have been connected under Project Gigabit, advancing the UK’s broadband rollout efforts.
Shift to Smart Building Contracts – A new report indicates a trend towards consolidating smart building technologies into single contracts, driven by cost efficiency and operational simplicity.
